people.hosea.role: Prophet whose family life pictures Israel’s broken faith
people.hosea.meaning: The LORD tells Hosea to take a wife and name three children. Hosea marries Gomer and gives the children the names he is told. Later he buys a woman for fifteen pieces of silver and barley. His speeches then charge Israel and call it to return.
people.gomer.relations: She is Diblaim’s daughter and Hosea’s wife. She bears a son, a daughter, and another son.
people.gomer.meaning: Hosea takes her as his wife. She bears Jezreel, Lo-Ruhamah, and Lo-Ammi. The LORD gives each child a name. The text gives her no speech and no reasons. It does not name the woman Hosea buys in chapter 3.
places.samaria.summary: The LORD speaks about Samaria in chapters 7, 8, 10, and 13. He names its lies and its calf idol. He says Samaria and its king will float away like a twig. It will fall by the sword.
places.samaria.limits: The marker shows the city or its wider region. The text gives no exact spot.
places.egypt.summary: Egypt comes up in chapters 2, 7, 8, 9, 11, 12, and 13. The LORD recalls Israel’s rescue from Egypt. He says Ephraim calls to Egypt for help. He warns that Israel will return to Egypt, where Memphis will bury them.
places.egypt.limits: The marker shows the whole land of Egypt, not one site. Chapter 11 says Israel will not return there. Chapters 8 and 9 say it will.
sources.web.limits: This edition keeps the WEB wording. Family comparisons do not give a full household biography.
